component.name: SEZOY
component.summary: Network OS deployment server: PXE, USB boot media, automated setup

description.p: SEZOY by TekDT is a network OS deployment tool for technicians. Pick an ISO, pick a template, and boot or install machines over PXE, UEFI HTTP Boot, Wi-Fi AP boot, or USB boot media with automated Windows setup, drivers, post-install apps and monitoring.
Note: the boot server needs root (privileged ports, systemd service). Prefer the native .deb self-update channel on Linux.

v0.2.1.0-beta: 9 changed, 6 added, 3 fixed, 1 security. Highlight: Wired and wireless machines are served at the same time. The access point keeps its own small network for wireless machines while the wired network stays as it was.
